title: Quote: Customers can't anticipate what the technology can do. They ...
speaker: Steve Jobs
content: Customers can't anticipate what the technology can do. They won't ask for things that they think are impossible. But the technology may be ahead of them. If you happen to mention something, they'll say, 'Of course, I'll take that. Do you mean I can have that, too?' It sounds logical to ask customers what they want and then give it to them. But they rarely wind up getting what they really want that way.
